response.original_title: Maternités tragiques, aux origines du planning familial
response.overview: Accused of having let their fourth baby die for lack of care, the Bac couple stood trial at the Versailles Assizes in 1954, charged with infanticide. Called as a witness for the defense, gynecologist Marie-Andrée Lagroua Weill Hallé took the stand.
response.tagline: Precarious maternity experiences gave rise to family planning services. This is the story
response.title: Maternités tragiques, aux origines du planning familial
